items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 51:1
items.html: When the lower one rises as MAN to the upper one and returns Aba ve Ima of the upper one face to face, then the bottom Hey descends, and afterward the AHP are returned to the Partzuf, and the level of Gadlut comes out there for the sake of the lower one. Now, these AHP that returned to the Rosh due to the descent of the bottom Hey do not belong to the upper one at all; rather, they are the portion of the lower one who rose there as MAN. For example, if the lower one is AA, then the AHP that were returned by the illumination of the coupling through Aba ve Ima of Atik do not belong to Atik at all, since a complete NHY of Atik is already there, which it attained during its inclusion in the Rosh of SAG of AK. Moreover, the AHP that belong to Atik are of phase four and the level of Keter, whereas these AHP that came out through the power of the inclusion of the coupling of AA are only of phase three and the level of Hochma. Hence, although they came out in the Rosh of Atik, they nevertheless belong to AA. And so, when AA comes out from the Rosh of Atik and comes to its place, it takes with it the AHP that came out for its own MAN while it was in the Rosh of Atik. Now, on the one hand, one might consider them a part of Atik, since indeed they came out there in the Rosh of Atik; however, since they do not belong to the aspect of Atik, they must be considered the aspect of AA, and hence they descend as garments of Mochin and clothe the Rosh of AA. And so it is with all the Partzufim: those AHP that came out on account of their own MAN, in their inclusion in the upper one, are drawn with them when they go out from there to their own place, and are considered garments of Mochin for them, for the reason explained. And you already know that AHP are always considered the aspect of NHY. Hence we call these AHP by the name NHY. (Inner Light, page 637, Sub Header, “Now”)
